findings.title: Possible SQL injection in query
findings.explanation: User input appears to be interpolated into the SQL string, which allows injection.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a parameterized query with placeholders instead of string interpolation.

findings.title: Missing error handling on connection
findings.explanation: The connection call can raise; there is no try/except, so a failure crashes the request.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap the connection in try/except and return a handled error.
